# YouTube Ads Blocklist for Pi-hole

> A community-maintained list of YouTube ad-serving hostnames for DNS-level ad blockers. Add one URL to Pi-hole (v5 or v6), AdGuard Home, pfBlockerNG, Technitium, Blocky or any blocker that accepts a hosts-style domain list, and YouTube ads are blocked network-wide on every device. Updated every day or two from hostnames reported by users.

Subscribe URL (plain hostnames, one per line):
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kboghdady/youTube_ads_4_pi-hole/refs/heads/master/youtubelist.txt

Repository: https://github.com/kboghdady/youTube_ads_4_pi-hole
Author: Kirolos Boghdady (kboghdady)

## How to use

- Pi-hole: add the URL under Lists (v6) or Group Management > Adlists (v5), then run `pihole -g`.
- AdGuard Home: Filters > DNS blocklists > Add a custom list.
- pfBlockerNG: Firewall > pfBlockerNG > DNSBL > DNSBL Groups, add the URL as a feed.
- Technitium DNS: Settings > Blocking > Block List URLs.
- Script option (Pi-hole only): `git clone https://github.com/kboghdady/youTube_ads_4_pi-hole.git && cd youTube_ads_4_pi-hole && sudo ./youtube.sh` adds every domain to the Pi-hole denylist and can run hourly from cron.
- Keep `s.youtube.com` allowed. Pi-hole's default StevenBlack list blocks it, which breaks playback: `pihole allow s.youtube.com` (v6) or `pihole -w s.youtube.com` (v5).

## Files

- [youtubelist.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kboghdady/youTube_ads_4_pi-hole/refs/heads/master/youtubelist.txt): the list to subscribe to.
- [black.list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kboghdady/youTube_ads_4_pi-hole/refs/heads/master/black.list): the same list, downloaded by youtube.sh.
- [ignore.list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kboghdady/youTube_ads_4_pi-hole/refs/heads/master/ignore.list): hostnames that must never be blocked because they break video playback. Both published lists are already filtered against it.
- [crowed_list.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kboghdady/youTube_ads_4_pi-hole/refs/heads/master/crowed_list.txt): raw, unfiltered community-reported hostnames. Blocks more but can break videos; optional.
- [youtube.sh](https://github.com/kboghdady/youTube_ads_4_pi-hole/blob/master/youtube.sh): the Pi-hole script (options: --dry-run, --no-share, --crowd).
- [README.md](https://github.com/kboghdady/youTube_ads_4_pi-hole/blob/master/README.md): full documentation, troubleshooting and privacy notes.

## Limits

- DNS blocking cannot stop every YouTube ad: ads and videos share the same googlevideo.com domains, and ads stitched into the video stream (server-side ad insertion) are invisible to DNS. A browser extension such as uBlock Origin or SponsorBlock is still needed for those.
- Devices that bypass your DNS (DNS-over-HTTPS, hard-coded DNS) are not covered.
- Some ads will slip through until the new hostnames reach the list, usually within a day or two.

## Privacy

Subscribing to the list sends nothing anywhere. The optional youtube.sh script shares only the googlevideo.com hostnames your Pi-hole saw in the last 24 hours (no IPs, clients or other domains); disable with --no-share.
